newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC BEATEN IN SWISS INDOORS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC BEATEN IN SWISS INDOORS.

text.p: Second seed Goran Ivanisevic led a parade of seeds to tumble out of the Swiss indoor championships on Wednesday when he lost in straights sets to German qualifier David Prinosil.
In his first tournament since losing to Pete Sampras in the semifinals of the U.S. Open, Ivanisevic went down 7-6 6-4 to the 65th ranked German.
Earlier, fifth seed and world number 14 Thomas Enqvist of Sweden was upset by French qualifier Olivier Delaitre 6-1 7-6.
Seventh seed Mark Philippoussis of Australia also lost, surrendering 6-1 4-6 7-5 to Swede Jonas Bjorkman 6-1 4-6 7- 5.
Ivanisevic, the world number four and winner of four tournaments this year, had won all three previous meetings against Prinosil, the Olympic doubles gold medallist.
"I just came back from Davis Cup on clay and only had one day to practise on this surface," Ivanesvic said. "It was difficult to play him because he played in three qualifying rounds.
"It might have been easier to play someone else. I was having difficult time returning."
